# New York Regions Inquiry Board

Subject: Social Studies
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Inquiry Board
NYS framework label: New York State K-12 Social Studies Framework

## Short Description
A question board for investigating New York regions through maps, images, short texts, and data.

## Alignment Note
Supports geographic reasoning, evidence gathering, and inquiry-based social studies.

## Classroom Use Case
Use as a station rotation during a New York State geography unit.

## Preview Content
- What makes this region distinct?
- Map evidence
- One question we still have

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
